summary: End-to-end workflow: requirements, agent design, prompts, retrieval, evals, security review and launch.
intents: take our ai assistant feature from prototype to production
plan, build, evaluate and launch an llm feature end to end
run the full launch workflow for our new support agent
what do we need before shipping this chatgpt-style feature
get our rag assistant ready for launch with evals and a security review
prerequisites: the user problem and the prototype or design
sample inputs and access to the model and data

steps.goal: Define the user problem, success metrics, unacceptable failures and human approval points
Choose workflow versus agent, define tools, permissions, handoffs, budgets and stop rules
Write and lint the system and task prompts with output formats and injection guards
Build and measure retrieval when the feature answers from documents
Score the feature on a held-out evaluation set and compare with the baseline
Threat-model prompt injection, data leakage through tools and abuse; confirm mitigations
Make the go or no-go decision with eval and security evidence, rollout and rollback plan

done_when: Evaluation results on a held-out set meet the success metric with stated uncertainty
Prompt-injection and data-leakage threats have mitigations or accepted owners
Irreversible agent actions require human approval
A rollout, monitoring and rollback plan exists
